notes.title: Button Button Up! Has Launched!!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29540960/33c4b2d7c1cc4d97b8a673cd53cbfbc9cab7bd41.gif[/img]

Today is a good day!

The tiny button grows up, and it's time to expedition !

"Button Button Up!" leaving early access,launch update available now! It’s time for everyone to witness our achievements over the past four years!

What have we done for this game?

The game started with a prototype of the Ludum Dare in 2015. Since then, we have decided to develop this game. So with these years of hard work and the pile of "tiny buttons" that can finally be show to everyone.

From the beginning of DEMO to the present, the game is little by little growing. At first we did a co-op mode with 90 levels in the full 3 chapters. In order to allow more people to experience the core gameplay more interestingly, four ompletely different styles chapters of single mode have been added. In order to create a more joyful atmosphere with the core gameplay, a local multiplayer mode was created with 2 different gameplays and 12 different maps. During the period we also experienced three art overturns and two changes to the bottom of the program. To this day, "Button Button Up!", our children, It's a good dress that really sets foot on its own road.

From now on, we will continue to care for it.

Without the support of all of us, we can't get there today. Jiangshan's father can accommodate me and not make money. So if there are any issues with the game, please continue to give us feedback and reports! We will listen to your opinions and further optimize the game! Thank you!

Good Good Study, Button Button Up!

notes.title: Announcement: full release at 10:30 today， 20% off！
Some stuff about Early Access and price increased
notes.notes:
Hello there~ 
Due to be busy with development and the difficulties encountered by the team, we left the steam community for a long time.
Starting today, we are back again~

[b][h1]About the Early Access:[/h1][/b]
A few months ago, due to insufficient experience and a mistake, <Button Button Up!> unexpectedly transition from Early Access to Full Release.
Sorry~ We didn't find it in time until we contacted Steam last week and found that it was a strange bug that led to the accident.

[b]Fortunately, we returned to the Early Access with the help of A-bro( Valve), and thank for his kind help!
[/b]
[b][h1]About the Price Increase:[/h1][/b]
After nearly three years of development, this Party Game is get close to completion.
The NS version will available on Eshop during the summer, and then the steam will be full released.

[b]Version comparison[/b]

The first Early Access version: cooperation mode has 3 chapters and 90 levels.
Current Early Access version: single mode 4 chapters, local cooperation mode 3 chapters 90 level, local single-person dual control challenge 3 chapter 90 level, local versus has 2 modes 12 maps.

Since all content is almost complete (V0.9999999999), we have raised the price to the full release price. In order to set discount on the day of the full release. (It was unable to set discount within 30 days after the price changed.)

[b]If you can't wait to get started with this game, please follow our recent social media campaigns or just buy the game.
It can also be add it in your wish list and waiting for the full release discount.[/b]

We hope everyone can have more fun in this game, and thank for your support ~

notes.title: ButtonBros VS Mode Updates are now available.
notes.notes:
[b]After experiencing all kinds of thrilling adventure experiences in the hands of players, the buttons finally gathered together, and in many players'reports, we found that the players were eager for a platform to play with their partners, so we made a big collection, let the buttons all move up! [/b]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29540960/63cba35d3d7cad120cca1900a6aa51795fb325ca.png[/img]

[h1][b]What's new? [/b][/h1]

[b]New Game Mode![/b]
[list]
[*] In the VS Mode, we have set up two modes of victory for everyone to choose. 
[*] The first is the occupancy point mode, in which you need to stand at the luminous spot continuously and steadily to get the score. The longer the occupancy time, the higher the score! 
[*] The second is the survival mode, in which everyone has a fixed number of lives, you need to protect yourself and defeat each other! 
[*] Up to four partners can play at the same time. 
[*] 
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29540960/a17f02329cf16d6bcff6eaa27c2cb5303b9b322b.gif[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29540960/5635901d800b3ef64442ebb5d57c78965334aa03.gif[/img]
[b]New maps. [/b]
[list]
[*] You can play 12 different styles of maps.
[*] Each map has its own unique trap mechanism and play method. 
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29540960/358e6700fbf6136307cf205ff11c25a80ccb74d6.png[/img]
[b]New props.[/b]
[list]
[*] Add 7 kinds of damage props.
[*] Add 1 defensive item.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29540960/d73ef5a1f1cdfaa77b79308a9c1ff23721bd46f6.png[/img]
[b]New clothes.[/b]
[list]
[*] We added 23 suits.
[*] And more! 
[/list]
[h1][b]What are the next plans? [/b][/h1]
We will update the new mode.

Thanks to everyone who participated in our open beta.

Rule: a score is scored by taking the Light Pad alone, the first 1000 points, or the top points after the time up as the winner！

notes.title: Button Bros is now available for Early Access! 0.5.1 Beta
notes.notes:
Dear players,

Our game Button Bros is now on Early Access. This version contains the following contents:
Two complete chapters with a total of 60 levels,; chapter 3 is also available with 3 trial levels
Steam achievements
Cloud Storage
Singleplayer challenges

We will add the following contents in the future:
Steam trade cards
Online Co-op mode
Multiplayer versus mode
Singleplayer story DLC
Original soundtrack
Digital comics

We will add more new contents to the game. So keep tuned and thank you for supporting us!
